description: Make one PDF from 1 to 20 pictures, one per page, in the order given. Free, with a daily limit per account. Give the file through get_upload_link (file_id) or a public link. The result link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned.

file_ids.description: file_ids from get_upload_link, in order. One upload link can hold several files: the user may choose them all at once there, and they come in the order chosen.

file_urls.description: Or public https links to each picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, GIF, BMP or TIFF), in order. Result links from other YangOpen tools work too.

page_size.description: fit: each page the picture's size. a4: each picture on an A4 page.

name: images_to_pdf
title: Put pictures into one PDF
